focus: The Anatomy of a Large-Scale Hypertextual Web Search Engine, Section 2.1.1: the PageRank calculation PR(A) = (1-d) + d (PR(T1)/C(T1) + ... + PR(Tn)/C(Tn)) with damping factor d, on a small graph of 4 pages. Let the learner edit the links and change d. Show the PageRank scores after iteration and the link graph. Guide them to see that d=0 gives equal ranks and that a page linked from important pages gains rank. Check that every page's rank satisfies the formula at convergence.
